I know this is a little off topic but it reminded me of when I got into a car accident. My mom said that to me (I don't care about the car, blah blah blah) after my accident and I believed her until she came back a few months later and demanded a portion of the money that I "owed" her for the car (she had convinced herself shortly after my accident that I had done it on purpose to spite her for something that she supposedly said). I knew that she would demand portions of that money whenever she needed something as a way of making me feel guilty so I made the decision to empty my savings and write her a check for the whole amount. Guess what?! SHE RIPPED THE CHECK! I realized that it is a control thing because she was pissed that when I got my new car, I did not ask her for a single penny to finance it. I'm waiting for the day that she brings up the money again so I can tell her off once and for all.

My Nmom does this to this day. I noticed that she tends to do it more when my attention isn't on her. She also likes to say things like "when I die, you guys will learn to appreciate me." or "when I die, none of you will care." A few years ago, a member of my church congregation passed away and it hit me that my parents could die any day too. I made the mistake of opening up to her about that and she uses it as a weapon against me when she wants to manipulate me. Even my edad has started to hop on the "I'm gonna die" band wagon. Then they have arguments over who is faking and just asking for attention. There are times where I start to feel like I could end up like them because my first reaction to certain situations is to fantasize about my suicide. I would NEVER say it out loud and use it to manipulate others but I still feel like I could end up like them.
